name: level1-lose-arrest
description: Level 1 losing scenario: heavy corruption and mafia use, triggering criminal arrest. #1409: smuggling no longer adds exposure and earns a share of operating income (a mine that does no mining earns $0), so it can neither win the level nor cause the arrest; the player picks a smuggling volume in the Shady panel and the arrest route is botched accidents, each of which can draw a police investigation (exposure +0.1 on success, +0.2 and an investigation on failure) until exposure reaches ARREST_EXPOSURE_THRESHOLD. Accidents target one employee each in command mode; interaction mode clicks the Shady panel's accident button, which picks the first living employee, so the two trajectories differ but both end in 'arrest'.

steps.description: cash:300000 funds eleven opening bribes (about $105,000 with fines), three extra hires and up to a dozen $10,000 accidents; the loss condition is corruption-driven arrest, not money. staffed:true gives the free starting crew, the accident targets.

role: bootstrap (issue #515): the cost:X override is a scenario-only convenience to hit an exact cash delta -- ShadyPanel's real "Make the Call" button always bribes at the fixed TARGET_COSTS rate (Corruption.ts), which does not match the scripted amount here, so no real click can reproduce this exact state change. ShadyPanel now DOES scope its buttons (data-target/data-action, issue #513) -- the earlier "no stable selector" reasoning was stale.

expect.note: the bribe's own success/scandal roll (attemptCorruption, corruptCommand -- events.ts) is RNG-driven and not asserted here, but the cost deduction (state.cash -= result.cost) happens unconditionally regardless of that roll, so cash is safe to assert exactly.

steps.description: First driller hired through the real Crew panel: open the panel from the toolbar, then click the driller row's Hire button.
Two more drillers (the rest of the candidate pool) hired with the Crew panel already open; repeating the toolbar click would toggle the panel closed.
role: player (issue #515, #1409): a real click on the Shady panel's quarter-volume smuggling button. Free and instant; a mine that does no mining earns nothing from it, and it adds no exposure.

expect.note: volume selection costs nothing; smuggling income is a share of operating income, which this scenario never earns.
